description: A Tax tab for Swedish investors: turns Avanza or generic CSV transactions into the K4 attachment for selling shares and funds, with average cost and the 20% flat rate, a BLANKETTER.SRU file Skatteverket can import, holdings, a what-if sale planner and a tax estimate.
name: Swedish tax (Skatteverket)

tab.description: Swedish capital gains tax on shares and funds: prepare the K4 attachment for your income tax return. Your files are processed in memory and are not stored.
tab.label: Tax

tools.description: Upload your transactions and get every K4 row (antal, beteckning, försäljningspris, omkostnadsbelopp, vinst, förlust), the totals for boxes 7.4/8.3, a tax estimate, and BLANKETTER.SRU for Skatteverket.

inputs.help: Avanza's transaction export (Konto → Transaktioner → Exportera) or the generic CSV from the Guide. Include the whole history, also earlier years, so the average cost is right. The files are processed in memory and not stored.
inputs.label: Transaction files
inputs.name: files

inputs.help: Account numbers exactly as in the Konto column. Leave out ISK, kapitalförsäkring, IPS and pension accounts: sales there are not declared on K4. Use Review import to list the accounts.
inputs.label: Accounts to leave out
inputs.name: exclude_accounts

inputs.help: One 'ISIN-or-exact-name=type' per line. Types: aktie, aktiefond, blandfond, ranfond, krypto, onoterad. Unlisted instruments default to aktie; check the types in the result.
inputs.label: Fix instrument types
inputs.name: classes

inputs.help: The 20% flat rate (schablonmetoden) is only used for listed shares, never for funds.
inputs.label: Cost basis
